pages.text: The chilling beauty of snow and ice, the fractal bite of frost. Suspended animation, preserving, freezing.

When a cold shrine is overfilled, excess spirits will affect the environment: 3 spirits will freeze a block of water or lava, or put snow layers on the ground. 24 spirits will turn snow into powdered snow. When a cold shrine is overdrawn, it will destroy layered snow to yield 3 cold spirits or turn powdered snow into snow to yield 18 cold spirits.
